title: Lunerim - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Lunerim in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Lunerim is a fire-element weapon used by Lune. It scales with Vitality (D), Luck (C).

sections.title: Is the Lunerim Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (D), Luck (C). A dedicated fire pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
